title: Page 9
content_zh:
天网恢恢，真相之所以会被发现，全都要从吴德亮意外抓到两个毒虫开始——

吴德亮的下属在巡逻的时候，逮到两个吸毒惯犯，吴德亮也认得他们，因为上次他们这对难兄难弟就是被吴德亮抓到入狱的，没想到他们出狱后又走上回头路。

本来照理来说，两个吸毒惯犯是引不起刑警队大队长吴德亮的关切，可他刚好注意到这起案件，其中主要的原因是，他记得这对难兄难弟手头并不宽裕，顶多只能到手一些便宜的毒品，可这回被逮到时，竟然搜出海洛因，而且分量还不少，吴德亮的职业病是直觉，看到那些成分很纯的海洛因，马上联想到他们不是去抢了银行，就是最近肯定做了什么作奸犯科的事。

于是他亲自审问这对难兄难弟，一耗就是八个钟头。

“你们买海洛因的钱是从哪里来的？抢来的还是偷来的？”

“不，是有人给的，还一次给了五十万。”

“那个人为什么要给你们钱？”

“她要我们兄弟俩替她做一件事。”

“什么事？”

“强暴一个女人，还是一个大美女。”

“所以你们真的照对方的话做了，然后拿到五十万？”

“没耶，没做成，但那个人还是给了我们五十万，说是当做封口费。”

真是大手笔啊，没有成功还能拿到五十万的封口费……不太对劲，真的不太对劲，但问题到底出在哪里？吴德亮用右手食指轻轻敲打着桌面，这是他思考时的习惯。

接着吴德亮又问：“那个大美女你们认识吗？”

兄弟俩你看看我、我看看你，支支吾吾的，就是不肯老实说。

吴德亮眼眸危险的一眯，反正他自有方法让他们开口吐实。

这对难兄难弟本来就是俗辣，一听到吴德亮说要将所有刑责统统算到他们头上时，他们吓傻了，该说的、不该说的都说了——

“对方是透过之前坐牢时认识的大哥联系上我们的，她说她会在对方的饮料里头下药，强暴之后她不会认得我们的，她只是想要那个女人身败名裂，没想过要她的命，只是当我们到对方说的地方时，没想到那个女人已经先一步离开，我们没有做成……

“但后来她真的死了，她死了，但真的不是我们干的，新闻说她是从楼梯上失足摔死的，跟我们一点关系都没有。”

一听到他们说那个女人是失足摔死的，吴德亮马上想到颜芳菲，于是他表情冷肃的问：“那个人要你们强暴颜芳菲？”

“对对，就是颜芳菲，她还传了照片给我们看，还叮咛我们不要认错。”

事情到此，真相已经清楚了一半，而另外一半，就是找出幕后的藏镜人。

吴德亮第一时间联络了赵霖，确定颜芳菲死亡前的确被下了药，而且就是在那场精品代理的派对上。

吴德亮揣测，颜芳菲应该是被下药后感到不舒服，才会提早离开，自己开车返家，也因此那对难兄难弟没有拦到人强暴成功，而在路上因为药效发作，她昏昏沉沉的，开了将近两个小时的车才回到家，这只能说她非常幸运，没有发生车祸，但她也非常的不幸运，人都平安回到家了，却因为一脚踩空摔死了。

如此一来，下药的人虽然没有犯下谋杀案，但也涉及了多条刑责。

“在派对里，所有跟颜芳菲接触过的人都有嫌疑，这范围也太大了，不好找吧。”赵霖说。

“不会，那个人用手机传了颜芳菲的照片给那对吸毒惯犯。”只要从通联纪录下手就对了。

“不会吧，对方应该不会蠢到用自己的手机。”赵霖虽然这么说，但他也很清楚，他和吴德亮心里都已经有了答案。只是那个人心机这么重，真的会犯这么愚蠢的错误吗？

“不是蠢，而是太过自负，以为绝对不会被抓到，就大方用自己的手机传照片，这种人很多，相信我。”吴德亮很有信心。

没想到凭着这一条线索，吴德亮真的顺利追查到真凶。

对于吴佩茹这个名义上的婆婆，白薇秀相当厌恶，每次只要一想到她曾经那样对待年仅十岁的赵霖，她真的很想帮亲爱的老公讨回公道，尤其现在得知她对颜芳菲做了什么，她更想狠狠揍她一顿。

赵霖拦住了冲动的她，表示这一回他不会轻易饶恕吴佩茹，毕竟是一条人命，况且吴佩茹敢对颜芳菲下药，难保她以后不会为了钱或是继承权，做出其它更卑鄙的事，但他更害怕的是，吴佩茹会将脑筋动到白薇秀身上。

颜芳菲死了，他是自责但并不伤心，也尽力完成当初答应她的条件，照顾好她的家人，可白薇秀不同，她是他最心爱的女人，握在手心呵护还怕弄疼她的女人，若她发生什么意外，他绝对会疯掉。

为了白薇秀，他决定将吴佩茹这颗毒瘤从赵家拔除。

但吴佩茹也是个狠角色，被警方传唤到案说明时，带着一名律师随行，整个问讯过程始终保持缄默，全都由律师代答，而且一切罪行她一概否认，一直强调手机在事发当天之前就搞丢了。

赵耀山也来到警局关切，他相信吴佩茹的清白，她好歹是集团总裁夫人，没必要做出这样的事。

赵霖随后也到了，父子俩差不多同时间进入刑事警察局，赵耀山被请到侦讯室的隔壁，透过经由特殊处理的玻璃，看到儿子跟妻子坐在另外一间的侦讯室里，两人正在说话，正确来说，应该是聊起往事——

“当我听到原来绑架我的教唆人是你时，要不是因为我精神跟体力都太虚弱，搞不好会因为太过震撼而从地上跳起来。”赵霖冷冷的道。

吴佩茹的眼神闪了闪，坚决否认，嘴硬是他听错了，她还痛哭出声，无辜的说如果他硬要诬赖她，她也没有办法。

“父亲说过，赵氏是要留给我的，你跟赵瑜、赵谚能分得的，只有他拥有股份中的一小部分，你不甘心，但你又没胆弄死我，怕弄死我以后会被怀疑，所以干脆找人想要逼疯我，我疯了之后当然不可能接管赵氏，既得利益最多的人便是你。”

不管是赵瑜或赵谚接管赵氏，以他们双胞胎对家族事业无感的情况下，幕后操控的人唯有吴佩茹。

赵霖一点也不担心她不承认，直接拿出证据。

“我已经调查过，其实你给了颜芳菲一大笔钱，要她接近我，最好可以让我喜欢上她，最后再想办法弄疯我，但你没料到的是，我知道颜芳菲的目的之后，反倒利用了她，你会跟颜芳菲谈条件，用钱收买她，难道我就不行吗？”

他是个谈判高手，用来引诱颜芳菲的条件优于吴佩茹太多了，颜芳菲想都没想就答应跟他合作，把她跟吴佩茹之间的协议，不管是口头的还是白纸黑字的，统统交给了他。

吴佩茹得知他跟颜芳菲结婚的消息后，就在派对举行的那一晚，找了个机会私底下跟颜芳菲谈话，她指示颜芳菲接下来该怎么做，却被颜芳菲拒绝了，吴佩茹恼火，想要给颜芳菲一个教训，于是偷偷在她的饮料里下药，然后找人强暴她，如此一来，一举两得，颜芳菲身败名裂，赵霖也会被打击到，但吴佩茹当时还不知道他们只是要假结婚。

赵霖说的每一句话，都如同刀子般，一刀一刀割着赵耀山的心，他这才惊觉自己识人不清，居然把一只贪婪的白眼狼给娶回家，还害了他最爱的儿子。

Skynet is in full swing, and the truth was discovered all because Wu Deliang accidentally caught two poisonous insects——

When Wu Deliang's subordinates were patrolling, they caught two habitual drug addicts. Wu Deliang also recognized them because the two brothers were caught and imprisoned by Wu Deliang last time. Unexpectedly, they turned back after they were released from prison.

Logically speaking, the two habitual drug addicts would not have attracted the attention of Wu Deliang, the captain of the criminal police team, but he happened to notice this case. The main reason was that he remembered that the two victims were not well-off, and at most they could only get some cheap drugs., but when he was caught this time, heroin was found, and there was a lot of it. Wu Deliang's occupational disease was intuition. When he saw the heroin with very pure ingredients, he immediately thought that they had either robbed a bank, or they must have done something criminal recently.

So he interrogated the brothers in person, which lasted eight hours.

"Where did you get the money to buy the heroin? Was it robbed or stolen?"

"No, someone gave it to me. They even gave me half a million yuan at a time."

"Why did that person give you money?"

"She asked us brothers to do something for her."

"What's the matter?"

"Rape a woman, and she's still a beautiful woman."

"So you actually did what the other person said and got half a million?"

"No, it didn't happen, but the person still gave us half a million, saying it was used as hush money."

It’s such a generous move. You can get half a million in hush money even if you don’t succeed... It doesn’t feel right, it really doesn’t feel right, but what is the problem?Wu Deliang tapped the table with his right index finger, which was his habit when thinking.

Then Wu Deliang asked: "Do you know that beautiful woman?"

Brothers, you look at me and I look at you. They are hesitant and refuse to tell the truth.

Wu Deliang's eyes narrowed dangerously. Anyway, he had his own way to make them tell the truth.

This pair of troubled brothers were inherently vulgar. When they heard that Wu Deliang said that all the criminal responsibility would be placed on them, they were frightened. They said everything they should and should not say——

"The other party contacted us through the older brother we met when he was in prison. She said that she would put drugs in the other party's drink. She would not recognize us after the rape. She just wanted the woman to be ruined and did not want to kill her. But when we got to the place where the other party said, we did not expect that the woman had already left first. We failed...

"But then she really died. She died, but it was really not us. The news said that she slipped and fell from the stairs and died. It had nothing to do with us."

When Wu Deliang heard that they said that the woman slipped and fell to her death, Wu Deliang immediately thought of Yan Fangfei, so he asked with a cold expression: "That person wants you to rape Yan Fangfei?"

"Yes, it's Yan Fangfei. She even sent us photos and told us not to admit our mistakes."

At this point, half of the truth has been revealed, and the other half is to find out the person behind the scenes.

Wu Deliang contacted Zhao Lin immediately and confirmed that Yan Fangfei had indeed been drugged before her death, and that it was at the boutique agency's party.

Wu Deliang speculated that Yan Fangfei felt uncomfortable after being drugged, so she left early and drove home by herself. Therefore, the couple did not stop the victim and successfully raped her. On the way, she was groggy due to the effects of the drug and drove for nearly two hours before returning home. This can only be said that she was very lucky and did not have a car accident. But she was also very unlucky. Everyone got home safely, but she fell to death because of a foot fall.

In this way, although the person who drugged the drug did not commit a murder, he was also involved in many criminal liabilities.

"Everyone who had contact with Yan Fangfei at the party was suspected. The scope was too large and it would be difficult to find." Zhao Lin said.

"No, that person used his mobile phone to send photos of Yan Fangfei to the pair of habitual drug offenders."Just start with the communication records.

"No, the other party shouldn't be stupid enough to use his own mobile phone."Although Zhao Lin said this, he also knew very well that he and Wu Deliang already had the answer in their hearts. It's just that that person is so scheming, would he really make such a stupid mistake?

"It's not stupid, it's just that I'm too conceited. I think I will never be caught, so I just use my mobile phone to upload photos. There are many people like this, believe me.”吴德亮很有信心。

Wu Peiru's eyes flashed and she denied firmly. She insisted that he had heard wrongly. She even cried out and said innocently that if he insisted on falsely accusing her, there was nothing she could do.

"Father said that the Zhao family will be left to me. What you, Zhao Yu and Zhao Yan can share, he only owns a small part of the shares. You are not willing to accept it, but you don't have the guts to kill me. You are afraid that if you kill me, you will be suspected in the future, so you just find someone to drive me crazy. Of course, I will not be able to take over the Zhao family after I go crazy. The person with the most vested interests is you."

Regardless of whether Zhao Yu or Zhao Yan takes over the Zhao family, given that the twins have no interest in the family business, the only person behind the scenes is Wu Peiru.

Zhao Lin was not worried at all that she would not admit it and directly presented the evidence.

"I have already investigated. In fact, you gave Yan Fangfei a large sum of money to get close to me. It would be best to make me fall in love with her, and then find a way to drive me crazy. But what you didn't expect was that after I knew Yan Fangfei's purpose, I took advantage of her. You would negotiate terms with Yan Fangfei and buy her with money. Am I not the same?"

He was a master negotiator, and the conditions he used to seduce Yan Fangfei were much better than Wu Peiru's. Yan Fangfei agreed to cooperate with him without even thinking, and handed over all the agreements between her and Wu Peiru, whether verbal or in black and white, to him.

After Wu Peiru learned the news that he and Yan Fangfei were getting married, she found an opportunity to talk to Yan Fangfei privately on the night of the party. She instructed Yan Fangfei what to do next, but Yan Fangfei refused. Wu Peiru was annoyed and wanted to give herYan Fangfei learned a lesson, so she secretly drugged her drink, and then found someone to rape her. In this way, she killed two birds with one stone. Yan Fangfei was ruined, and Zhao Lin would also be hit. But Wu Peiru didn't know at the time that they were just going to have a fake marriage.

Every word Zhao Lin said was like a knife, cutting Zhao Yaoshan's heart one by one. Only then did he realize that he didn't recognize people well enough that he had married a greedy white-eyed wolf home and killed his favorite son.
